relevance.rationale: Shows that the reduced quantum hyperbolic invariants of pseudo-Anosov diffeomorphisms of punctured surfaces are intertwiners of local representations of quantum Teichmuller spaces, and characterises them as the ONLY intertwiners satisfying natural cut-and-paste TQFT operations whose traces give mapping-torus invariants. The setting -- q a primitive odd N-th root of unity, quantum-hyperbolic state sums over layered triangulations, elementary intertwiners identified with Kashaev 6j-symbols -- is the root-of-unity face the corpus works on, and the hypothesis class (fibred cusped 3-manifolds) contains the corpus's own knots since 4_1 is fibred. Supporting rather than core: no corpus derivation consumes a quantum-hyperbolic-invariant theorem, and the folio does not compute invariants of mapping tori. Its value is (a) a citation for the quantum-dilogarithm-equals-6j-symbol identification that rem:q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator asserts, and (b) a literature analogue of the uniqueness-by-coherence argument shape prop:archimedean-functor-uniqueness uses.

keyResults.statement: The elementary intertwiners associated to diagonal exchanges between ideal triangulations are identified with the Kashaev 6j-symbols.
keyResults.useForFolio: Sources the parenthetical 'equivalently the 6j-symbol' in rem:q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator's claim that the quantum dilogarithm is the quantum associator, which is currently asserted with only faddeev_kashaev1994 behind it.

keyResults.statement: The reduced quantum hyperbolic invariants are the unique intertwiners compatible with the cut-and-paste operations of a TQFT and having mapping-torus-invariant traces.
keyResults.useForFolio: A published instance of the argument shape prop:archimedean-functor-uniqueness relies on -- coherence plus trace-invariance pins the object -- in the same root-of-unity setting; useful as a model for how such a uniqueness claim is stated and what it must exclude.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the corpus has no quantum-Teichmuller or quantum-hyperbolic-invariant reference at all despite working the root-of-unity state-sum face.
rem:q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator equates the quantum dilogarithm with the 6j-symbol without a source for that identification.
